Americans Abroad Midweek Preview: Pulisic, Adams, and more

September 15, 2026September 14, 2026 by Larry Henry Jr
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:43
Instaread

Christian Pulisic delivered an impactful substitute performance in AC Milan’s 2-2 Serie A draw on Saturday and will now aim to force his way into Ruben Amorim’s starting lineup this week.

Reserve Soccer Fields

Pulisic and his Rossoneri teammates welcome Benfica to the San Siro on Thursday in UEFA Europa League action. The U.S. Men’s National Team attacker delivered one assist over the weekend and finished as one of the better performers in the match.

Despite not featuring in AC Milan’s opening three matches of the season, Pulisic showed glimpses of what he can bring to the field when healthy and confident.

The 27-year-old is still seeking his first AC Milan goal of 2026 after failing to do in the final five months of the 2025-26 campaign. However, with a strong 45 minutes already under his belt, the odds will be on Pulisic’s side to find the back of the net on Thursday as AC Milan seeks a positive start to its European schedule.

Elsewhere in Europe, Tyler Adams and Bournemouth visit Pellegrino Matarazzo‘s Real Sociedad. Tanner Tessmann and Lyon visit Anderlecht while Malik Tillman and Bayer Leverkusen host Cejle.

In England, Antonee Robinson and Fulham visit West Ham United in EFL Cup. Aidan Morris, Sebastian Berhalter, Max Arfsten, and Rokas Pukstas and Middlesbrough host Millwall in EFL Championship action.

Elsewhere, JJ Williams and C.J. Fodrey go head-to-head in Scottish Premiership action. Erik Palmer-Brown and Panathinaikos visit Kifisia FC in Greek Cup action. Matthew Hoppe and Sonderjyske visit AB in Danish Cup play.

Here is a closer look at this week’s Americans Abroad:

Europe

UEFA Europa League

Christian Pulisic, Yunus Musah and AC Milan host Benfica on Wednesday.

Weston McKennie and Juventus host NEC Nijmegen on Thursday.

Tyler Adams and Bournemouth visit Pellegrino Matarazzo‘s Real Sociedad on Thursday.

Tanner Tessmann and Lyon visit Anderlecht on Wednesday.

Malik Tillman and Bayer Leverkusen host Cejle on Wednesday.

Bryan Reynolds and Stade Rennes visit Sturm Graz on Wednesday.

Tim Weah and Marseille visit Besiktas on Thursday.

Cameron Carter-Vickers, Auston Trusty and Celtic host Ferencvaros on Thursday.

Chris Richards, Zavier Gozo and Crystal Palace host Lech Poznan on Thursday.

England

EFL Cup

Antonee Robinson and Fulham visit West Ham United on Tuesday.

Championship

Aidan Morris, Sebastian Berhalter, Max Arfsten, and Rokas Pukstas and Middlesbrough host Millwall on Tuesday.

Track Live Scores

Spain

La Liga

Johnny Cardoso and Atletico Madrid host Osasuna on Wednesday.

Alex Freeman and Villarreal visit Malaga on Thursday.

Scotland

Premiership

Auston Trusty, Cameron Carter-Vickers and Celtic visit St. Johnstone on Wednesday.

JJ Williams and Hearts visit CJ Fodrey and Falkirk on Tuesday.

Greece

Cup

Erik Palmer-Brown and Panathinaikos visit Kifisia FC on Tuesday.

Denmark

DBU Pokalen

Matthew Hoppe and Sonderjyske visit AB on Wednesday.
